note: 结构化自 tools.json 中 api 类的已核实 limits 散文——同一批事实的机器可读形态，不新增任何数字。每条 slug 指回工具条目，来源与核实日期以该条目为准。kind 分五型：recurring（按周期刷新的限额）/ one_time（一次性额度）/ free_models（官方明示免费模型但未列速率数字）/ varies（按模型区分、官方要求看实时表）/ unstated（官方未公布数字）。

entries.caveat_zh: 常被引用的典型档位，各模型不同，以控制台 rate-limits 实时数字为准；不限总量、无需绑卡
entries.caveat_en: Typical widely-cited tier; per-model figures differ — the console rate-limits page is authoritative. No total cap, no card needed

entries.caveat_zh: 仅限 ID 带 :free 的 20+ 个 $0 模型；一次性充 $10 后升至 1,000 次/天（该存款不过期）
entries.caveat_en: Free (:free) models only, 20+ of them; a one-off $10 top-up lifts it to 1,000/day and the deposit never expires

entries.caveat_zh: Trial Key 每月 1,000 次；Chat 每分钟 20 次、Embed 每分钟 5 次——月额度没用完也会被分钟级限速卡住
entries.caveat_en: Trial key: 1,000 calls/month; Chat 20/min, Embed 5/min — the per-minute gate can bite before the monthly one

entries.caveat_zh: 每天 10,000 Neurons（统一推理计量单位），token 折算随模型不同——无法换算成统一的请求数，按官方折算表估算
entries.caveat_en: 10,000 Neurons/day (Cloudflare's unified inference unit); token conversion is per-model — use the official conversion table

entries.caveat_zh: 官方文档设「免费模型」板块：GLM Flash 系列 API 调用免费；可核实引文中未列明速率数字
entries.caveat_en: Official docs keep a dedicated free-models section: GLM Flash-series API calls are free; no rate figures appear in verifiable quotes

entries.caveat_zh: 加入免费 Developer Program 后官方措辞「unlimited prototyping」——用途限定在开发与测试，生产流量不在此列
entries.caveat_en: With the free Developer Program, official wording is "unlimited prototyping" — development and testing only, not production traffic

entries.caveat_zh: 免费层按模型区分 RPM/RPD、按项目计、太平洋时间零点重置；2025-12 官方大幅下调过一轮——以官方 rate-limits 实时表为准
entries.caveat_en: Free-tier RPM/RPD are per-model and per-project, resetting at midnight Pacific; officially cut hard in Dec 2025 — the live rate-limits table is authoritative

entries.caveat_zh: 注册送 14 元（官方口径约合 2,000 万 Qwen1.5-14B tokens），实名再得 16 元代金券；折算随模型档位变化
entries.caveat_en: Sign-up grants ¥14 (officially ≈20M Qwen1.5-14B tokens); ID verification adds a ¥16 voucher; conversion shifts with model tier

entries.caveat_zh: 注册自动送 $1（约合 70B 级模型 100 万 token），无需绑卡
entries.caveat_en: Sign-up auto-grants $1 (≈1M tokens on a 70B-class model), no card required

entries.caveat_zh: 每款模型各 100 万 tokens、互不相通，覆盖 70+ 款；开通日起 90 天有效
entries.caveat_en: 1M tokens per model (not pooled) across 70+ models; valid 90 days from activation

entries.caveat_zh: 绑定并验证支付方式后得 $5、30 天到期；上下文 8,192 tokens；官方明示无自动续期的免费档——token 折算官方未给统一口径，不代算
entries.caveat_en: $5 after adding a verified payment method, expires in 30 days; 8,192-token context; officially no renewing free tier — no official token conversion, so we don't invent one

entries.caveat_zh: 每账号每月一笔 Inference Providers 试用额度、可跨服务商，但免费档具体金额官方未在可核实页面写明
entries.caveat_en: Every account gets a monthly Inference Providers trial credit usable across providers, but the free amount is not stated on any verifiable official page

entries.caveat_zh: 经 HF Inference Provider 接入享每月小额配额（官方博客口径，未给数值）；DeepStart 创业计划另可申请最高 10 亿 tokens
entries.caveat_en: A small monthly quota via the HF Inference Provider route (official blog wording, no figure); the DeepStart program separately offers up to 1B tokens on application
